name: Somfy RTS (rolling code, identification only)
description: Blind and awning remote on the unusual frequency 433.42 MHz, Manchester coded, with a rolling counter that changes on every press. Framing is anchored to the software sync mark of about eight half-bits: Somfy prepends a wakeup pulse and several hardware sync pairs of about 2560 us, and without an anchor the codec would read those as data and misalign the 56-bit window. The sync's trailing space is matched leniently because it runs into the first half-bit of data. FIELDS CANNOT BE DECLARED YET: the payload is obfuscated by an XOR chain (each byte XOR the previous one) and the schema has no primitive for that, so this definition exposes the raw frame; a transform primitive would be needed to name control, counter and address here.
